name: Campingplatz Magdalena
beschreibung:
Campingplatz Magdalena is nestled within the impressive mountain scenery of the Tyrolean Ausserfern, offering excellent conditions for a restorative camping holiday. This welcoming site provides spacious pitches with breathtaking mountain views and comfortable sanitary amenities.

The surrounding Reutte region features crystal-clear alpine lakes, traditional alpine pastures, and expansive hiking trails, making it a wonderful base for families and outdoor adventurers alike.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Magdalena in the Ausserfern region impresses with sunny panoramic views and proximity to alpine lakes.
